title: USA's Simmers, Brazil's Medina rule inaugural WSL PH Pro Champions
summary: American star Caitlin Simmers and Brazilian ace Gabriel Medina emerged as champions in the first-ever World Surf League (WSL) Championship Tour Philippines Pro at Cloud 9 in Siargao on Tuesday.
